lines: Signed out, timed, and written into the book like every rigger since 1791.
You are the four hundred and something. Nobody has ever counted properly.
Six Crests before we open the back door. Frostmere's is the sixth.
That is not us being grand. It is three gantries a tile wide in a crosswind.
Gale and Spark Hall. Everyone in Skyreach calls it the Masthouse and always has.
We catch the wind for the whole city. The Hall is how we find out who else can.
Name in the book, and take these. Nobody goes out on the spurs without them.
Not because anything out there will hurt you. Because we are not fools.
Keeper Fenn is at the foot of the great mast and she will not come in for you.
Back door, three gantries, and read the board on the sill before you cross the first one.
